proposals.reasonJa: “God raised him up” refers to Jesus, the person killed in 10:39.

proposals.reasonJa: “ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead” refers to Jesus, carried over from 10:39–40.

proposals.reasonJa: “He commanded us ... this is he who is appointed” continues Jesus as the risen and revealed person in 10:40–41.
proposals.webText: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.
proposals.immediatePriorWebText: not to all the people, but to witnesses who were chosen before by God, to us, who ate and drank with him after he rose from the dead.

proposals.reasonJa: Peter remains the speaker: 10:46 says “Then Peter answered,” and 10:47 continues his quoted question.
proposals.webText: “Can anyone forbid these people from being baptized with water? They have received the Holy Spirit just like us.”

proposals.reasonJa: “He commanded them” is Peter, the speaker in 10:46–47; “they asked him” addresses Peter.
proposals.webText: He commanded them to be baptized in the name of Jesus Christ. Then they asked him to stay some days.
